name: Europlug (CEE 7/16, EN 50075)
description: Flat, non-rewirable two-pole plug without earthing contact, rated 2.5 A, 250 V, for class II equipment. Two round pins with insulated sleeves, slightly converging. EN 50075 defines the plug only; it fits most European round-pin socket-outlets.

mechanicalNotes: Pins 19 mm long: 9 mm conductive tip of 4 mm diameter, 10 mm insulated sleeve of at most 3.8 mm diameter.
Pin centres 17–18 mm at the tip and 18–19 mm at the base: the pins converge slightly.
Body 35.3 mm wide and 13.7 mm high with side faces at 45°.
Non-rewirable, moulded on its cord; EN 50075 defines no matching socket-outlet.

notes: The rating comes from the EN 50075 title and scope; the dimensions come from a secondary source citing EN 50075, whose text was not reviewed.
Frequency is not stated by the cited sources.
The CEE 7/17 plug (10 or 16 A) and the unearthed CEE 7/1 socket-outlet, also called type C, are not modelled here.

Mating with the type J (T13), K, L (10 A and bipasso) and N (NBR 14136) socket-outlets relies on secondary sources (WorldStandards and the target families' sources); type O (TIS 166) is reported compatible too but not recorded, as the tis-166 family does not state it. It does not fit type G sockets, and in type D sockets it cannot be fully inserted, so neither is recorded as a mating.
The front view relies on secondary sources for the body outline; pin spacing is drawn at 18 mm.
